privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.technical.heading: Technical data
privacy.technical.body: To protect the forms and reactions from spam, I keep a hashed fingerprint of your IP address for a few minutes, never the IP itself. Reactions only store counts. Your browser only keeps your preferences (language, theme, keyboard shortcuts and the reactions you marked). I use no analytics or tracking cookies.
meta.privacy.title: Privacy
meta.privacy.description: What data I collect on this site, what I use it for and how to ask to review or delete it.
